name: Payload Assembly (Demo)
description: 5-step human-object assembly experiment for on-board BAS experiments

steps.label: Pick up Object A
steps.instruction: Pick up Object A (Red Block) from its resting position.
steps.success_announcement: Step 1 complete. Place Object A on Object B.

steps.label: Place Object A on Object B
steps.instruction: Place the red block on top of the wooden block.
steps.guidance: Place Object A on Object B.
steps.success_announcement: Step 2 complete. Pick up Object A again.

steps.label: Pick up Object A again
steps.instruction: Pick up the red block from Object B.
steps.success_announcement: Step 3 complete. Return Object A to the tray.

steps.label: Return Object A to Tray
steps.instruction: Return the red block into the tray.
steps.guidance: Return Object A to the tray.
steps.success_announcement: Step 4 complete. Press the Complete Button.

steps.label: Press the Complete Button
steps.instruction: Press the complete button to conclude the experiment.
steps.guidance: Press the Complete Button to finish.
steps.success_announcement: Experiment completed successfully. All steps verified.
